versions.idNote: agbcc's libc.a: newlib, compiled by old_agbcc -O2 -fno-builtin from agbcc's libc/ sources; the id names the compiler, since each compiler builds its own. libc-agbcc is the whole archive of the pinned agbcc, so members no game links (memcmp, which agbcc calls for a block compare) have a signature; the games add the members only another agbcc fork builds (sa3's math functions) and show that real ROMs hold the same bytes

__sbprintf@vfiprintf.o.name: __sbprintf_i
__sbprintf@vfiprintf.o.reason: vfprintf.o and vfiprintf.o (the same source without floating point) each define a static __sbprintf; every label of a version must be unique, so the integer-only one takes the _i suffix, after the i of vfiprintf

__sprint@vfiprintf.o.name: __sprint_i
__sprint@vfiprintf.o.reason: vfprintf.o and vfiprintf.o (the same source without floating point) each define a static __sprint; every label of a version must be unique, so the integer-only one takes the _i suffix, after the i of vfiprintf
